news.title: Kyrie Irving scores 25, Cooper Flagg 22 as the Mavericks top the Clippers 110-100
news.text: — Kyrie Irving scored 25 points and Cooper Flagg had 22 points, eight rebounds and six assists as the Dallas Mavericks used a late 11-0 run to beat the Los Angeles Clippers 110-100 on Saturday night.

news.title: Wembanyama and Castle help Spurs bounce back from loss to Pistons and beat Clippers 124-112
news.text: — Victor Wembanyama had 32 points and 11 rebounds, Stephon Castle added 21 points and 12 assists, and the San Antonio Spurs held off the Los Angeles Clippers for a 124-112 victory on Thursday night.

news.text: — Brook Lopez scored 26 points and Darius Garland added 24 as the Los Angeles Clippers finished off a 113-112 victory Friday night in an NBA Cup game, sending the short-handed Oklahoma City Thunder to a season-high third straight loss.

news.title: Clippers beat Pelicans to end 7-game losing streak
news.text: — Darius Garland had 24 points and 10 assists, Brook Lopez added 20 points and the Los Angeles Clippers ended a seven-game losing streak with a 139-123 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans on Sunday night.
